project.name: Netflix
project.description: Promise-Driven Development refactor of Netflix product promises

productPromises.statement: As a Subscriber, watch any title I want, instantly.
productPromises.description: Core promise of on-demand access to the full library without delay.

epics.description: Ensure that any title can be played within seconds, regardless of network conditions.

journeys.statement: New to Netflix, set up my account
journeys.description: First-time user completing signup and becoming ready to watch.

moments.statement: Plan is selected so that subscription is set up for Subscriber.
moments.description: Coordination with billing system to apply chosen plan.

moments.statement: Payment information is processed so that account is activated for Subscriber.
moments.description: Job coordinating user, payment gateway, and Netflix billing.

journeys.description: Subscriber who has previously signed in and wants to resume watching quickly.

flows.description: Immediate access to continue watching row and fast playback start.

moments.statement: Select a title from 'Continue Watching' row

journeys.statement: User on slow or unstable connection
journeys.description: Subscriber with bandwidth constraints expecting smooth playback without long buffering.

flows.description: System automatically adjusts quality to maintain playback.

moments.statement: Bitrate is automatically lowered so that playback continues without stalling for Subscriber.
moments.description: Job coordinating network conditions and CDN.

moments.statement: Buffering indicator is minimized so that user perceives less interruption for Subscriber.
moments.description: System hides buffering events when possible.

epics.description: Help users find shows and movies they'll enjoy through browsing, searching, and recommendations.

moments.statement: Search results are displayed so that user can find titles for Subscriber.
moments.description: Coordination with search index and personalization engine.

epics.description: Allow users to create profiles, rate content, and manage watchlists to tailor Netflix to their preferences.

moments.statement: Enter profile name and choose icon
Click thumbs up or thumbs down icon
Click '+ My List' on a title

epics.description: Ensure smooth playback, resume across devices, and convenient controls like skip intro.

moments.statement: Skip Intro button appears so that user can bypass opening for Subscriber.
moments.description: System detects intro segment and displays button.

moments.statement: At end of episode, click 'Skip Credits'
Episode ends so that next episode can be queued for Subscriber.
Countdown is displayed so that user knows next episode will start for Subscriber.
Next episode starts automatically so that binge-watching continues for Subscriber.
moments.description: System initiates playback of next episode.

epics.description: Allow users to manage their subscription, payment methods, and billing details.

moments.statement: New plan is applied so that subscription changes take effect for Subscriber.
moments.description: Coordination with billing system and proration logic.

moments.statement: New payment details are submitted so that billing continues for Subscriber.
moments.description: Coordination with payment gateway and fraud detection.

moments.statement: Billing history is displayed so that Subscriber can review charges.
Invoice PDF is generated and downloaded so that Subscriber has records.

productPromises.statement: As a Traveler, download and watch offline without internet.
productPromises.description: Allow users to download movies and shows to watch without an internet connection.

moments.statement: Find a downloadable title (look for download icon)
Download completes so that title is available offline for Subscriber.
Downloaded titles list is displayed so that Subscriber can manage storage.
moments.description: Query local storage and present list.

moments.statement: Delete a download to free space
Open Netflix and go to 'My Downloads'

productPromises.statement: As a Multi-device user, watch seamlessly on any device I own.
productPromises.description: Provide seamless experience across phones, tablets, computers, TVs, and game consoles.

moments.statement: Activation code is displayed so that user can link device for Subscriber.
Go to netflix.com/activate on phone/computer and enter code
Install Netflix from App Store/Google Play
Browse and play content on mobile

productPromises.statement: As a Parent, keep my kids safe with parental controls.
productPromises.description: Allow parents to restrict content and create kid-friendly profiles.

journeys.statement: Set maturity rating for existing profile

moments.statement: Go to Account > Profile & Parental Controls

flows.statement: Require PIN to access specific profiles
